cases.translation: A jar of sour wine stood there.
cases.explain: Кувшин is the subject of стоял ('stood'), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Солдаты сплели венок из ___ и надели ему на голову.
cases.translation: The soldiers wove a crown out of thorns and put it on his head.
cases.explain: The preposition из ('out of, made from') governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Своему же ___ он сказал, «Вот твоя мать».
cases.translation: To his disciple he said, 'Here is your mother.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал ('said to someone') places the person addressed in the dative case.

cases.translation: Then Pilate ordered Jesus to be flogged.
cases.explain: Бичевать ('to flog') takes its object in the accusative case; for this animate proper noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Вместо этого один из солдат пронзил ___ бок Иисуса, и из него сразу же потекли кровь и вода.
cases.translation: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus's side with a spear, and blood and water immediately flowed out.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the instrument used ('pierced with a spear') without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Там, где Иисуса распяли, был сад, и в ___ новая гробница, где еще никого не хоронили.
cases.translation: In the place where Jesus was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb where no one had yet been buried.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in') governs the prepositional case; сад takes the special locative ending -у ('в саду').

reading.ru: Солдаты сплели венок из терновника и надели ему на голову.
reading.question: What did the soldiers make and put on Jesus's head?
options: A crown of thistles and roses
reading.explain: The soldiers wove a crown of thorns and put it on Jesus's head.

reading.ru: «У нас есть закон, и по нашему закону он должен умереть, потому что называет себя сыном Бога».
reading.question: What reason did the Jews give for demanding Jesus's death?
options: He claimed to be the Son of God
reading.correct: He claimed to be the Son of God
reading.explain: The Jews said their law required his death because he called himself the Son of God.

reading.ru: У тебя не было бы надо мной никакой власти, если бы она не была дана тебе свыше.
reading.question: What does Jesus tell Pilate about his authority?
options: Pilate's authority was given to him from above
Pilate has no real authority at all
Pilate's authority came from Caesar alone
Jesus refuses to acknowledge Pilate's authority
reading.correct: Pilate's authority was given to him from above
reading.explain: Jesus tells Pilate he would have no power over him unless it had been given from above.

reading.ru: «У нас нет царя, кроме Кесаря», — отвечали первосвященники.
reading.question: What did the chief priests declare when Pilate asked if he should crucify their king?
reading.explain: The chief priests answered that they had no king but Caesar.

reading.ru: Там Иисуса распяли, а с ним по обе стороны еще двоих.
reading.question: How many others were crucified along with Jesus?
options: Two others, one on each side
reading.correct: Two others, one on each side
reading.explain: Jesus was crucified with two others, one on each side.

reading.ru: Пилат приказал прикрепить на кресте табличку с надписью «Иисус Назарянин, царь иудеев».
reading.question: What did the sign on Jesus's cross say?
options: "Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews"
reading.correct: "Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews"
reading.explain: Pilate had a sign placed on the cross reading 'Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.'

reading.ru: «Что я написал, то написал», — ответил Пилат.
reading.question: How did Pilate respond when the chief priests objected to the inscription?
options: "What I have written, I have written"
reading.correct: "What I have written, I have written"
reading.explain: Pilate refused to change the inscription, saying 'What I have written, I have written.'

reading.ru: «Бросим лучше жребий и посмотрим, кому она достанется».
reading.question: What did the soldiers decide to do with Jesus's seamless tunic instead of tearing it?
options: Cast lots to see who would get it
reading.correct: Cast lots to see who would get it
reading.explain: The soldiers decided to cast lots for the seamless tunic instead of tearing it.

reading.ru: «О, женщина, вот твой сын», — сказал Иисус матери.
reading.question: What did Jesus say to his mother from the cross?
reading.explain: Jesus told his mother, 'Woman, here is your son,' entrusting her to the beloved disciple.

reading.question: What did Jesus say just before he died?
reading.explain: After tasting the wine, Jesus said, 'It is finished,' and then died.

reading.ru: Вместо этого один из солдат пронзил копьем бок Иисуса, и из него сразу же потекли кровь и вода.
reading.question: What did a soldier do when he found Jesus already dead?
options: He pierced Jesus's side with a spear, and blood and water flowed out
He broke Jesus's legs like the others
He took Jesus's body away immediately
He tried to revive Jesus with water
reading.correct: He pierced Jesus's side with a spear, and blood and water flowed out
reading.explain: Instead of breaking his legs, a soldier pierced Jesus's side, and blood and water flowed out.

reading.ru: Никодим принес смесь из смирны и алоэ, литров около ста.
reading.question: What did Nicodemus bring for Jesus's burial?
options: A mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred liters
reading.correct: A mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred liters
reading.explain: Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred liters, for the burial.
